definitions.explanation: A particular point or stretch of time, often characterized by certain events or conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧{時期|じき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossom season is approaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{時期|じき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a good time to change jobs.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{時期|じき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦やすい→～やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It's easy to catch a cold during this time of year.

notes:
{時期|じき} refers to a particular time or period, often with seasonal or situational connotations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時期|じき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (the time comes)
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{時期|じき} (good time)
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{時期|じき} (this time of year/period)
- ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧{時期|じき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (at an early stage)
- {時期|じき}⟦{尚早|しょうそう}→尚早：noentry⟧ (premature, too early)

COMPARISON:
- {時期|じき}: time period, season (specific point or span)
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: era, age (longer historical period)
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: season (spring, summer, etc.)
